title: Maple Sausage Donut Breakfast Sandwiches
description: A hearty breakfast sandwich featuring maple cured breakfast sausage donuts, eggs, peppers, onions, bacon, and cheese on brioche buns, drizzled with maple syrup.
steps: Preheat the griddle to medium-high heat and grease with bacon fat.
Cook sliced poblano peppers and thick-sliced sweet onion until browned.
Add bacon slices and cook until browned.
Push the cooked peppers, onions, and bacon into the cool zone of the griddle.
Add the maple cured breakfast sausage donuts to the cool zone and slow cook until cooked through.
Toast brioche buns in the background.
Once the sausage donuts are cooked through, crack eggs into the center of each donut, cover, and cook until eggs are basted and set.
Add cooked peppers, onions, and bacon on top of the eggs.
Place a slice of white American cheese on top.
Drizzle the brioche buns with maple syrup.
Assemble the sandwich by placing the sausage donut with toppings on the bun, then top with the other half of the bun.
Finish with an additional dollop of maple syrup.

healthy: Poblano peppers and onion add some vegetables.
not_healthy: Sausage and bacon are processed meats high in sodium and saturated fat.
Brioche buns and maple syrup add refined carbs and sugar.
American cheese and bacon fat add more saturated fat.
